rounds.text: IL&FS Engineering & Construction Co Ltd presents a precarious financial profile characterized by severe liquidity constraints and a disconnect between market valuation and fundamental reality. The company’s current ratio of 0.14x indicates that current liabilities vastly exceed current assets, leaving the firm in a vulnerable position [E32]. This liquidity risk is compounded by negative operating and free cash flows of Rs -112 Cr and Rs -114 Cr respectively [E29, E30]. Furthermore, the stock trades at a P/E of 49.38x, which is significantly higher than the sector benchmark of 14.42x, while the EV/EBITDA ratio of 154.13x dwarfs the sector average of 8.58x [E6, E11]. The company also faces a substantial burden of Rs 1,562 Cr in contingent liabilities [E54]. Conceded: the company has shown recent improvements in profit growth and operating margins [E19, E24, E25]. Despite these operational shifts, the stock remains fundamentally overvalued according to a discounted cash flow analysis, which suggests a margin of safety of -35.3% [E40].
